title: viburnum recognitum
intro: Viburnum recognitum, commonly known as the Highbush Cranberry, is a deciduous shrub native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the potential to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum recognitum include antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
